home.description: Carl Avidano’s selected work for Datadog: accessible design-system ownership, adoption, UX leadership, and collaboration with developers.
home.headline: I build accessible design systems and lead design teams.
home.introduction: Hi, I’m Carl, and I’m excited to apply for Datadog’s Senior Design Manager role. I’ve built and maintained an accessible design system used across multiple projects, alongside managing and mentoring designers over the past five to seven years. Helping your team shape DRUIDS and support the people who build with it is an opportunity I’d be excited to take on.
home.projectsIntroduction: I’ve tailored the following case studies to highlight the work and outcomes most relevant to DRUIDS: maintaining a shared system, helping others use it, and bringing teams together around complex design decisions.
